text: Payout batch failures: when the nightly payout batch reports FAILED_UPSTREAM, the cause is almost always an expired bank authorisation mandate. Re-authorise under Settings > Payouts > Bank mandate. Batches retry automatically within 4 hours of re-authorisation.

Card charge disputes: if a customer's card was charged on an unexpected date, check whether their billing anchor was changed by a plan upgrade. Upgrades reset the anchor to the upgrade date. This is expected behaviour, not a bug.
Double charges: duplicate charges occur when a payment is retried after a gateway timeout. The duplicate auto-voids in 7 days, but support can force-void immediately via the Billing console.
Refund timelines: refunds issued before 14:00 UTC settle same day. After 14:00 they settle the next business day. Card issuers may add a further 3-5 days before the customer sees funds.

Payout reconciliation drift: a persistent sub-1% discrepancy between reported and settled payout totals usually indicates FX conversion applied at settlement rather than at capture. Enable capture-time FX locking in Settings > Payouts.
SSO availability: SAML and OIDC single sign-on are included on the Growth plan and above. The Starter plan does not include SSO. SCIM user provisioning is Enterprise only.
API rate limits: the search endpoint is limited to 100 requests per minute per API key. Exceeding it returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header. Limits can be raised on Enterprise plans.

Password reset emails: if reset emails do not arrive, check whether the customer's domain has a DMARC policy of reject. Our transactional sender requires the customer to allowlist mail.example-service.com.
Mobile app crash on settings tab: a known defect on Android 14 affects devices with the system font scale above 130%. Fixed in app version 4.12.2, released last week.
Shipping delays: tracking numbers that have not updated for more than 7 days should be escalated to the carrier claims process. Customers are eligible for a shipping refund after 14 days.

Unauthorised admin access: if a customer reports a login from an unrecognised IP, immediately revoke all active sessions via the Security console, force a password reset, and export the audit log for the affected window.
Invoice VAT rates: invoices generated before 1 April use the previous VAT rate. Invoices can be reissued at the corrected rate by support without affecting the payment record.
